messages:
Rhea: Heads-up: onboarding failures with encoder-decoder shards. Bench passes but runtime concat + kv-merge causes decode misalign and higher latency on mixed-length traffic. Thoughts?
Diego: Could be shard-level KV boundary — when we concat outputs across shards the cache offsets shift. Need a kv-handshake microtest in intake.
Sam: Suggest two cheap checks: tokenization parity on a canonical 40-sample set, and a "kv-offset smoke" where we run incremental decode and verify cache hit counts.
Rhea: Agreed. Also want a rank-preservation metric for top-10 logits (spearman) instead of raw logits to tolerate scaling.
Diego: We should store these micro-signatures in model registry (token_hash, topk_spearman, kv_signature) so runtime can detect drift after uploads.
ops-bot: FYI: any registry write triggers an audit event; keep payload small.
Rhea: Action items: 1) add micro-compat runner to intake (token + topk rank + kv-smoke), 2) registry fields + drift alarm, 3) Console flag "compat override" for manual review.
ingest-bot: Task created: IN-6007 "micro-compat for encoder-decoder shards + registry drift"
